title: Average cost of the sequential OR tree
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $p$ satisfy $0<p<1$. For an input of $n$ independent signs, each equal to $-1$ with probability $p$ and to $1$ with probability $1-p$, the expected number of coordinate queries made by the sequential OR decision tree is $\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(1-p)^k$.
